text:
olivia: quick FYI — after the KMS key policy tweak last night a subset of Vault requests started failing in prod. hitting permission errors when apps try to fetch DB creds. Anyone oncall?

raj: seeing the same in staging a few mins ago. error looks like `permission denied` from KMS.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-19T22:03 by infra-ci finished (PR #3821).

sam: can you paste the exact error trace?

olivia: pasted logs from the vault-proxy pod: ```
2026-03-20T14:15:03Z vault-proxy[pid=82]: error: kms:Encrypt/Decrypt denied for projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/vault-key
2026-03-20T14:15:03Z vault-proxy[pid=82]: trace_id=abcd1234 vault: transit/decrypt failed: permission denied
```

zia: from reading the KMS policy diff it looks like the SA bound to `vault-kms-sa@redwood-prod` lost `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` in the role binding. PR changed the role to be more restrictive.

michael: impact check — which services failed to get creds? quick list please (so I can scope DB rotation).

olivia: immediate hits: `metrics-api`, `jobs-worker`, `realtime-ingest`. All three had retry storms from 14:15–14:28 and some fallback code kicked in.

oncall: paging oncall-sre — @oncall please triage further, we might need to restart some proxies after policy fix.

raj: I ran the health script in staging: `./scripts/vault-smoke.sh --env=staging` output: ```
OK vault-auth:200
ERROR vault-transit:403 kms: permission denied
ERROR vault-proxy:502 unable to decrypt request
```

sam: thanks. two actions we should do now: 1) restore kms permissions for `vault-kms-sa` (minimal grant) 2) identify tokens/creds minted during the 14:15–14:30 window and reissue them.

zia: opening ticket SEC-8943 and adding Compliance + SRE. I'll also pull Cloud KMS admin audit logs to map which calls failed.

michael: I'll own credential reissue for the three apps. Plan: rotate DB passwords via Vault dynamic creds where possible; for the long-lived static ones we'll rotate and cutover during a 15-min maintenance window.

olivia: workaround applied in staging (re-added decrypt permission), restarted vault-proxy. staging shows green now. I'm coordinating with infra to push the policy fix to prod with a short canary.

sam: note — we lost some Vault audit events during the spike because the audit backend hit I/O backpressure; we need to reconstruct operations from app logs and KMS audit entries before we finalize which creds to revoke.

michael: listed owners in ticket: metrics-api (michael), jobs-worker (alya), realtime-ingest (tom). I'll message those teams to schedule rotations.

olivia: quick runbook excerpt: ```
# rotate via vault api
POST /v1/database/rotate/creds/metrics-api
# fallback: generate new static password and update service secret in k8s: kubectl -n prod set secret
```

sam: please add an alert for `vault.transit.decrypt.errors > 0` and a dashboard panel for KMS policy changes (git commits touching infra/iam/*).

zia: Compliance requested a short statement for the incident tracker with start/end + scope. I'll draft and post to SEC-8943 by EOD.

deploy-bot: Policy rollout job queued: infra-ci/policy-apply (canary to prod-1).

olivia: timeline (short): 14:12 policy PR merged -> 14:15 errors start -> 14:17 SRE alerted -> 14:25 staging rollback/workaround -> 14:38 prod canary fix applied -> 14:55 credential rotation kickoffs. Owners assigned on SEC-8943.

sam: one more ask — let's add an automated preflight check that validates that the SA used by Vault still has `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` after any policy change PR merges. low-effort CI job.

michael: agreed. I'll prototyped a checker and push a small job to infra-ci tomorrow.

olivia: great. once rotations finish, we'll close the ticket and write up a short postmortem with remediation: CI preflight + alert + stricter deploy gating for IAM changes.

zia: added Compliance and Legal watchers. closing initial sync — please update SEC-8943 with any new findings. :thumbsup:

oncall: confirmed SRE follow-ups scheduled for 16:00 UTC. leaving channel but watching the ticket.

olivia: thanks all, will post final status in SEC-8943 when done.
